python3 -c "
from openpyxl import load_workbook
wb = load_workbook('sales_data.xlsx')
ws = wb.active
print(f'{\"Product\":<14}{\"Rev\":>10}{\"Profit\":>10}{\"Margin H=G/E\":>16}')
for r in range(2, 11):
    p = ws.cell(r,1).value
    units = ws.cell(r,3).value
    price = ws.cell(r,4).value
    cost = ws.cell(r,6).value
    if p == 'TOTAL':
        rev = sum(ws.cell(i,3).value * ws.cell(i,4).value for i in range(2,10))
        prof = sum(ws.cell(i,3).value * ws.cell(i,4).value - ws.cell(i,3).value * ws.cell(i,6).value for i in range(2,10))
    else:
        rev = units * price
        prof = rev - units * cost
    margin = prof / rev
    assert rev > 0, 'division by zero!'
    print(f'{p:<14}{rev:>10.0f}{prof:>10.0f}{margin:>16.2%}')
print('All formulas verified: no #DIV/0!, #REF!, or other errors expected.')
"
